title: Strong conventional comparisons and missing physical qualification remain explicit
statement: Exact milestoning/full-state CTMC solves and the same-data stage recurrence tie the initial compiler when complete boundary/kernel information is acquired. The integrated300-state true-generator solve is separately a stronger-information oracle. Ordinary confidence intervals on the SAME four short assays with the SAME two-mode/monotone theorem produce the same task-only sign certificate. Full spectral/Prony/HMM parameter recovery asks for a stronger ill-conditioned output;recorded200k,1m,5m,20mper-assay experiments leave conservative rare-yield intervals overlapping,but do not defeat an ordinary task-focused test. Nonparametric truncated-moment robust optimization is a strong valid comparator and cannot distinguish the exact three-mode aliases. Direct full-run Monte Carlo is a weak incumbent,not the sole baseline. Source-rational countermodels,seeded stress tests and SciPy floating solves/interval endpoints retain their different guarantees;no script was replayed by Capital. All-length confidence follows from four simultaneous parameter intervals PLUS the structural theorem,not new evidence at every length. Real specimen preparation,reset,monitoring,calibration,physical actuation and model-class acquisition are unmeasured. No full-support physical two-mode mechanism,robust finite-sample rank certification,wet-lab/biological validation,novelty or superiority established.

requires: Killed excursions need complete prepared boundary/gateway microstates,all failure routes,unchanged hidden excursions under admitted boundary actions,and rho(K)<1. Permanent exponential degradation gives a Laplace-discounted success interface,not a deterministic deadline CDF.

Task theorem needs exactly two distinct persistent propensities in[0,1],positive weights,fresh independent specimens,conditional stage independence and stable action responses;the alternate arbitrary-mode theorem needs a qualified monotone contrast.
provides: Exact statement above, at the stated contract.
costs: Charge every short assay,stage attempt and simulated physical reaction clock. Real preparation/reset/readout/action calibration remain unmeasured. Exact rational fixtures,float solves,statistical confidence and physical model qualification are distinct.
contract.units: Success probability,Laplace discount,all-length ordering,statistical confidence,physical reaction time,jumps and preparation costs remain separate.
contract.obstruction: Synthetic conditional construction,not physical qualification or independent scientific review. Complete support/microstate preparation,stable persistent-mode law or independently justified monotone response are essential and unlearned from four short assays. Exact three-mode aliases/rare contamination defeat generalization. No novelty,superiority,device,wet-lab or operational chemistry claim;previous held transfers remain excluded.
